title: continuous-valued-settling
description: A settling whose value category is a continuum V (a Lawvere quantale, continuous lattice, or fuzzy/residuated logic) rather than a finite bilattice - the first generalization of the settling's value category, recovering the standard bilattice-valued settling when V is Boolean or FOUR.

value-category.description: the continuous value category V: a complete weighted (Lawvere-quantale) lattice or small monoidal closed category with continuum-valued hom-sets, e.g. [0,infty] additive, [0,1] fuzzy, R additive, MV/BL/residuated lattices

continuum-valued.description: hom/truth values range over a continuum, not a finite bilattice

monoidal-closed.description: carries a tensor (cost addition, fuzzy product/min) and a complete-lattice order with meets

base.description: the base B = (L, C, E, lambda) the settling lives over

L.description: the value/logic carrier L of the base

C.description: the site C whose opposite the presheaf maps out of

E.description: the entity data E of the base

lambda.description: the labelling/closure data lambda of the base

enriched-presheaf.description: a V-enriched presheaf v : C^op -> V-Cat, replacing the bilattice-valued presheaf

enriched-closure.description: a V-enriched closure operator T_V : v |-> T_V(v), monotone and inflationary in the V-sense

settling-stage-advancement.description: stage advancement that is V-enriched throughout, either discrete-time iteration of T_V or a continuous semigroup T_t for t in [0,infty)

settled-fixed-point.description: v_kappa is the closure-stable fixed point under T_V at the closure ordinal kappa: T_V^kappa(v) = T_V^(kappa+1)(v)

closure-ordinal.description: the ordinal (or real time, or +infty) kappa at which closure stabilizes, classified by the four-regime dichotomy

kappa.description: an ordinal in discrete time, or a real number / +infty in continuous time

regime.description: strict (kappa finite/small), scott-continuous (kappa = omega or countable-rate infinity), transfinite-bounded (kappa countable transfinite), aperiodic (kappa >= omega_1)
